title: Measuring and calculating waves
design_rationale: Move from operational measurement to the derived wave equation.
concepts_taught: Use y-gain to determine signal amplitude.
Use time-base and cycle count to determine period and frequency.
Derive v = fλ from one wavelength travelled in one period.
Select and rearrange v = fλ consistently with units.

next_module_can_assume: Use y-gain to determine signal amplitude.
Use time-base and cycle count to determine period and frequency.
Derive v = fλ from one wavelength travelled in one period.
Select and rearrange v = fλ consistently with units.
next_module_must_not_assume: Compare oscillation direction with wave travel direction.
